reason: Article 13(6) of DORA requires entities to ensure that staff members are provided with appropriate training on ICT security and digital operational resilience. This provision directly supports the control objective of mandatory training, even without specifying a minimum number of hours.
applicability_note: This mapping is applicable to all financial entities and groups subject to the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA).
challenge_comment: The challenge is that the regulation does not specify a minimum number of training hours, which could lead to inconsistent implementation across different entities.
